+title: 'AVK-8t Structure test: no .tint modifier in the kit, and the kit sets no theme of its own (D111 step 7, D112 (d))'
+---
+## Why
+
+D111 step 7 (`style.md` "Procedure"): "Semantic colors and SF Symbols. Use `.tint` only on the primary action." `style.md` "The accent": "Use `.tint` only on the primary action."
+
+D112 (d): "The app injects the theme once at the root of each window with `.editorTheme(_:)`. A view kit sets no theme and no color constants of its own." `style.md` "Injection": "A view kit sets no theme of its own and has no color constants of its own."
+
+Facts from a search on 2026-10-20:
+- No file in `Sources/AgentViewKit` calls the `.tint(_:)` view modifier. The primary action of the composer gets its color from `.buttonStyle(.glassProminent)` (`Input/DefaultPromptAccessory.swift:94`, `:173`), not from `.tint`.
+- The `tint` names in the kit are other APIs: `Theme.tint(for:)` (`Theme/Theme+StatusRoles.swift:93`, `:108`, used at `Status/TaskListView.swift:209` and `Status/SessionNoticeBanner.swift:171`), the `tint` properties of `Thread/ThreadMinimapView.swift:94` and `Activity/ActivityTimeline.swift:182`.
+- No file in `Sources/AgentViewKit` calls `.editorTheme(`. `AgentTheme` holds no color (`Theme/AgentTheme.swift:8-14`). The demo injects the theme at the root: `Examples/AgentViewKitDemo/AgentViewKitDemo/AgentViewKitDemoApp.swift:26` (`.editorTheme(.system)`).
+- `Input/SpeechInputButton.swift:85` uses `.foregroundStyle(.tint)` on the recording symbol. This card does NOT forbid it. It is an open question (comment on ^b316bqv).
+
+This card adds a guard so that the facts stay true.
+
+## Files
+
+- New: `Tests/PackageStructureTests/ThemeInjectionTests.swift`, with fixtures in `Tests/PackageStructureTests/Fixtures/ThemeInjection/`.
+- Use `SourceLineScanner.codeMatches(inSwiftFilesBelow:relativeTo:skipping:match:)` (from ^b316bqv).
+
+## What to do
+
+- [ ] Scan `Sources/AgentViewKit`, code lines only. Report each `.tint(` that is a view modifier: a `.tint(` with no identifier character directly before the dot (for example a line that starts with `.tint(` or `) .tint(`). Do not report `editorTheme.tint(for:`, `glass.tint(` or a `tint:` argument.
+- [ ] Scan `Sources/AgentViewKit`, code lines only. Report each `.editorTheme(` call and each `DefaultTheme.` use. A kit view reads the theme only with `@Environment(\.editorTheme)`.
+- [ ] Previews are code too. If a `#Preview` needs a theme, it injects nothing and gets `SystemTheme`. If a preview needs a fixed theme, put that preview in the demo, not in the kit.
+- [ ] Add fixtures: one bad line for each form, and a clean file with `editorTheme.tint(for: severity)`, `glass.tint(accent)` and each form in a comment and a string.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- `ThemeInjectionTests` passes on the current sources.
+- The fixture test reports each bad form with its file and line, and nothing in the clean file.
+- Tests use Swift Testing. No clock, sleep, poll, retry, timeLimit or XCUITest. #avk-8
\ No newline at end of file
